products.title: OFF SHFT Logo Hoodie
products.descriptionHtml:
The O in OFF is a clock. The hands say 5:00.

Quitting time. Shift's over. Hood up.

For the couch, the dock and the drive home.

Made to order and shipped to you.

Details

  • Left chest: the OFF SHFT logo, about 63 mm (2.5 in) wide, embroidered on the Oversized and Garment-Dyed styles
  • Styles: Oversized, Garment-Dyed or Lightweight
  • Oversized: relaxed fit, dropped shoulders. 80% cotton, 20% recycled polyester fleece, 9.4 oz/yd² (319 g/m²). Lined hood with no drawcord, front kangaroo pocket
  • Garment-Dyed: relaxed fit. 80% ring-spun cotton, 20% polyester, 9.5 oz/yd² (322 g/m²), garment-dyed after sewing
  • Lightweight: relaxed fit. Lightweight fleece, 100% ring-spun cotton, 6.4 oz/yd² (217 g/m²), garment-dyed. Jersey-lined hood

Which size? See Size & fit.

products.title: The Clock Sweatpants
products.descriptionHtml:
A clock with its hands at 5:00. Quitting time.

It's the clock from the OFF SHFT logo, on its own. Off the clock, on the couch.

Nowhere to be and all day to get there.

Made to order and shipped to you.

Details

  • Leg: the clock, on the front of the left leg, about 25 mm (1 in) tall
  • Fabric: lightweight garment-dyed fleece, 100% ring-spun cotton, 6.4 oz/yd² (217 g/m²)
  • Flat cord at the waist

Which size? See Size & fit.
